answers.answer: Rule by warriors plus buildings: strict most; ordinary ties mean nobody rules. Eyrie wins ties if it has an Eyrie piece there. Tokens and pawns do not count; Vagabond cannot rule or prevent rule.

Move a positive number of your warriors/pawns along a linking path to an adjacent clearing; rule the origin, destination, or both, rechecking each move. The same pieces may move repeatedly. Rivers are not paths absent an explicit effect.

Defender may ambush for two immediate hits; attacker can foil with matching ambush. Battle ends if no attacking warriors/pawns remain. Rolled hits are capped by own warriors (Alliance reverses dice; Vagabond uses undamaged swords); extra hits are uncapped, with defenseless bonus. Hit-taker chooses removals, but removes all warriors before buildings/tokens. Whoever removes enemy buildings/tokens scores 1 VP each.

Craft from hand by activating matching bottom-left crafting icons, not paying card suit; each crafting piece once per turn (Vagabond pawn exception). Item cards need item in map supply. Identical persistent effects already in play cannot be crafted. Unsupported: crafting costs details beyond activating icons.

In own Daylight at 10+ VP, activate dominance from hand; stop scoring and cannot replace/discard activated card. At start of own Birdsong, win by ruling three clearings of matching suit, or two diagonally opposite corners for bird.

A spent dominance card goes near the map available instead of discard. During own Daylight, spend a matching card to take an available dominance into hand; bird dominance remains bird, so requires bird payment. Bird card may pay for non-bird.

Two players remove all four dominance cards; each draws three. Cover four R slots with ruins; map item supply is 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins. If Vagabond present hide one each R-marked bag/boot/hammer/sword, one per ruin; otherwise ruins empty. Faction setup order Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond.

Only Marquise may place pieces in keep clearing; others may move into it. When Marquise warriors are removed, it may spend a matching clearing card to put them in keep clearing instead of supply. Keep cannot be placed again once removed. Without keep, hospitals have no destination.

Daylight: craft, then up to 3 actions plus one per bird card spent outside an action, any order. March up to two moves as one uninterrupted action. Recruit once per turn, one warrior per recruiter; Overwork spends matching card to place one wood at sawmill.

Build in clearing you rule with open slot, choosing type and leftmost building. Pay full wood cost from target clearing or linked chain of ruled clearings; score VP on uncovered track space. Must have wood, building and legal slot.
Birdsong: Emergency Orders draw one if hand empty; add one or two cards to Decree, at most one bird; then if no roosts, place roost and three warriors where fewest warriors and all pieces fit.

Craft with roosts first, then Decree columns Recruit, Move, Battle, Build. Bird wild; each card compulsory. Within a column choose card order freely. Build requires matching clearing ruled, open slot, and no roost already there.

Turmoil: lose 1 VP per bird Decree card including both Viziers; discard Decree cards except Viziers; flip current leader down and choose face-up replacement (if none face-up, flip all up); retuck Viziers. Daylight ends; proceed to Evening. Map warriors/buildings remain. Evening scoring still occurs.

Another player triggers Outrage by removing sympathy or moving any warriors into sympathetic clearing. They add one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters; if none, show hand and Alliance draws from deck. If supporter stack full, incoming card is discarded.

Birdsong Revolt first, any number, then Spread Sympathy any number. Revolt uses sympathetic clearing with no base, matching a base on board; pay two matching supporters; remove enemy pieces, score buildings/tokens, place base/warriors/officer. Spread into unsympathetic clearing adjacent to sympathy (or anywhere if none); pay printed supporters plus one if any one other player has at least three warriors there (Martial Law).

Train in Daylight by spending hand card matching clearing with base to place supply warrior in Officers. Officers permit Evening operations. Losing base discards matching supporters including birds, removes half officers rounded up; if no bases remain, cap supporters at five.

Refresh two exhausted items per face-up tea on Refresh track, then three more. Optional Slip moves adjacent clearing/forest without boots, ignores leaving restrictions. Normal move exhausts boot plus one extra if destination has Hostile faction warriors; ignores rule, cannot enter forest. Evening forest Rest repairs damaged items/turns them face up; draw one plus face-up coins regardless.

Explore exhausts torch in ruin clearing, takes hidden item and scores 1 VP if item taken; remove ruin with last item. Quest exhausts its two listed items; score matching quest count or draw two, then replace quest. Repair exhausts hammer and moves one damaged item to Satchel retaining face.

Removing one warrior of non-Hostile faction makes it Hostile immediately (except special allied-warrior hits rule). On own-turn battle, Infamy is +1 VP per hostile piece removed, except warrior that first caused Hostility; no Infamy defending or from Strike. Aid cannot undo Hostility. Strike removes warrior, or another faction piece only if no warriors of that faction in clearing.

With 4+ players and 10+ VP, Vagabond may activate dominance during own Daylight to coalition with player not already in coalition having lowest VP among others (choose tie). You and partner win if partner wins; partner may win by dominance. Hostile partner resets to Indifferent. Partner is not enemy; coalition does not grant Allied powers.
Card overrides Law; Law overrides Learning to Play. General and faction rules apply together where possible; faction rule wins if incompatible. Cannot is absolute unless explicitly overridden.
For unclear simultaneous effects, player taking turn chooses. March is compound and cannot be interrupted to take action or spend bird between its moves.

At-start effects precede other phase effects; at-end effects follow all others in that phase before next phase. Once last step of turn begins, no other actions except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions.

Hand size public, contents private; show/reveal only when instructed. Face-up piles inspectable; deck cannot be inspected. Agreements non-binding; cards transfer only as instructed; actions need no consent.

When deck empties, immediately shuffle discard into new deck. Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, even multiple same-suit payments; forced non-bird give/discard also allows matching birds. Explicit bird cost cannot be substituted by non-bird.

Pieces finite; no proxies. If cannot place all prompted pieces, place as many as possible. Shortage does not waive costs/prerequisites or Eyrie obligation to complete Decree action. The summary does not explicitly say whether you may voluntarily place fewer when more are available.
answers.evidence: Actions—Battle/common removals; Special Rules—Force and pieces.

answers.answer: Placement normally from supply or leftmost track; removal to supply or rightmost empty track. Removed items leave game permanently. For simultaneous removal, remove all before triggering effects.
Forced actions resolve as if affected player chose them, retaining that player's abilities/restrictions; forced player makes battle decisions.

Enemy may move into Keep clearing, but cannot place there; replacing there is prohibited because placement ban cannot be bypassed. Swap ignores move/place restrictions; replacement requires both removal and placement possible.
If multiple players simultaneously reach 30, tied player closest clockwise to current player wins, including current player.

Forest adjacency: clearings touch forest without crossing printed path; forests separated by one printed path are adjacent. Winter river also divides forests, affecting Slip; Fall has no special rules.

Marquise supply: 25 warriors, 8 wood. Keep in any corner; one warrior in every clearing except diagonally opposite corner. Place one sawmill/workshop/recruiter in keep or adjacent clearings respecting slots; remaining five of each on tracks right-to-left, leftmost empty.

Supply 20 warriors; one roost and six warriors in corner not another player's starting corner (diagonal opposite if possible). Choose leader; keep others face-up; tuck two bird Viziers into that leader's specified columns. Other six roosts on track right-to-left.
Supply 10 warriors; put three bases in matching board spaces and ten sympathy on track; draw three additional cards face-down as Supporters, separate from three-card hand. No map pieces or officers.

Choose Thief/Tinker/Ranger; pawn in any forest; shuffle quests and display three face-up. Each other faction starts Indifferent. Take S-marked starting items; tea/coins/bags face-up on matching tracks, others face-up in Satchel; return unused S items.
Recommended minimum Reach: 17 for two players, 18 for three, 21 for four. Base values: Marquise 10, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5, Alliance 3. Law permits any mix totaling at least 17 as adventurous choice.
At Birdsong place one wood at each sawmill, limited by supply of eight; one per sawmill even if several share clearing. Evening draw one plus uncovered bonuses, then discard to five.
Recruit one at each recruiter once per turn; if supply cannot cover all, place maximum available, choosing which eligible recruiters.
Eyrie crafted items score 1 VP instead of printed VP under Disdain; other extra crafting-point effects still apply. Builder ignores Disdain and thus uses printed item VP.

Builder: Viziers Recruit/Move; ignores Disdain. Charismatic: Recruit/Battle; each recruit places two. Commander: Move/Battle; extra attacker hit. Despot: Move/Build; extra VP when removing enemy building/token in battle.

No. Decree Recruit requires one warrior at each matching roost (two with Charismatic); if action cannot be fully completed, Turmoil. Summary does not state a one-warrior partial placement fulfills it.
Guerrilla War does not remove warrior caps; Alliance defending uses higher die, attacker lower.
Supporters may only be spent for suit, not crafting; Alliance can inspect face-down stack. They do not count toward hand limit.

Yes. Birdsong resolves all Revolts before any Spread Sympathy, so sympathy spread that Birdsong cannot precede a Revolt in that same Birdsong. Existing sympathy could be Revolted; newly spread sympathy cannot be used for a later Revolt that phase.
No: Martial Law needs at least three warriors of one other player, not two players with two each. It adds one matching supporter to Spread Sympathy cost. No such surcharge for Organize.

Placing warriors in sympathy and moving only Vagabond pawn there do not trigger Outrage. Moving warriors into sympathy does; allied warriors accompanying Vagabond also move into it and trigger Outrage.
Evening operations up to officer count: Move, Battle, Recruit at base, Organize. Officers remain on board when used. Draw one plus uncovered bonuses after operations; discard to five.
Pawn cannot be removed; effect removing all enemy pieces damages three items instead. Applies to revolt and other enemy remove-all effects.
Rolled hit cap equals all undamaged swords in Satchel, face up or down. Vagabond defenseless only if no undamaged swords. Excess hits beyond undamaged items are ignored.

Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel move immediately to empty matching track space if possible; each track max three. Exhausting tracked item sends it to Satchel. Damage sends item to Damaged box without changing face. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

Capacity is six items plus two per face-up bag on bag track; Satchel and Damaged box count, track items do not. Check in final Evening step, permanently remove chosen excess items. Not checked immediately when acquiring items.

Forest Rest returns damaged items to Satchel and flips them face up; it does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Birdsong Refresh flips exhausted items. Repair moves one damaged item to Satchel, keeping current face.

Aid: exhaust any one item and give card matching clearing to player with faction pieces there, including Hostile; may take one item from their Crafted Items. Crafted item is optional. Advance relationship by number of Aid actions required in same turn; each Aid counts toward only one improvement.

At Allied, subsequent Aid scores 2 VP. May move warriors of one ally along with pawn subject to their own movement restrictions; may attack a different enemy using one ally's warriors, but not attack that ally itself. Coalition does not confer allied powers.
At battle end, ally becomes Hostile if Vagabond removes more allied warriors than items damaged in that battle, when using allied warriors to attack another enemy. Equal counts do not trigger.

No: one clearing must match all crafting icons, so fox and rabbit requirements cannot be combined there. Pawn may be reactivated by exhausting more hammers. Crafted item can immediately be taken face-up into Satchel/track.

Thief starts boot, torch, tea, sword; Steal exhaust torch to take random hand card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker: boot, torch, bag, hammer; Day Labor torch takes discard card matching clearing (bird always). Ranger: boot, torch, crossbow, sword; Hideout torch repairs three items keeping faces, ends Daylight and starts Evening immediately.
Taking last ruin item removes ruin and frees building slot. Ruins can be removed only when explicitly allowed; ordinary building placement does not remove them.
Coalition partners are not enemies; coalition does not automatically grant Allied relationship powers.

Two warriors removed: the first makes faction Hostile and earns no Infamy, second earns 1 Infamy VP; building earns ordinary 1 VP plus 1 Infamy VP (hostile piece) = 2. Total VP 3. Assumes all removals occur in own-turn battle as stated.
Only hostile buildings/tokens do not increase move cost: one boot. Any hostile faction warriors at destination require one extra boot total, regardless of number of Hostile factions.
Taking available dominance puts it in hand; it does not activate. Taking and activation are separate and neither uses faction action allowance.
Faction-piece ownership cannot change; items are not faction pieces and do not become owned by faction holding them.

Immediate-effect card resolves then is discarded. Persistent card stays in play; identical persistent effect cannot be crafted twice. A card in play is outside hand and cannot be spent/discarded/used otherwise unless explicitly instructed.
Ambush and dominance cannot be crafted. Ambush is used in battle; dominance can be spent for suit and when discarded becomes available near map.
answers.evidence: Actions—Craft; Dominance. Summary gives dominance uses but does not explicitly enumerate other ambush uses.

answers.answer: Choose starting player and seating randomly; place score markers at 0; dice nearby. Faction setup order Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond is distinct from turn order.
First to 30 wins immediately on any player's turn; no need to finish action, phase or turn.
Choose clearing containing your warriors or pawn and an enemy there as defender. Summary does not say whether clearing must be ruled; ordinary rule is not listed as battle prerequisite.
Attacker chooses order of applicable before-roll and after-roll effects if both players have them. Player taking hits chooses order of effects triggered by its pieces' removal.
Count hits by adding extra hits (uncapped by warriors) and subtracting ignored hits.
Non-Vagabond item crafting takes item from map supply into Crafted Items and scores listed VP, subject to Eyrie's Disdain; ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items as Vagabond does.
Eyrie uses roosts; Alliance sympathy. Crafting piece suit equals its clearing suit; three-color question mark accepts any suit.
Mobilize adds a hand card to Supporters respecting cap. Alliance Daylight permits crafting, Mobilize and Train in any order and number, so no need to finish crafting first.
Eyrie Evening scores VP on rightmost empty roost-track space; draws one plus uncovered bonuses, then discards to five. This occurs even after Turmoil.
Exhaust one sword to initiate Vagabond Battle. Exhausted undamaged sword counts for hit cap, but cannot pay action cost because actions require face-up undamaged item.
Turn phases are Birdsong, Daylight, Evening; turns pass clockwise, so next player's Birdsong begins after Evening.

Each hit damages one undamaged item of Vagabond's choice, placing it in Damaged box without changing face. Already damaged items cannot absorb another hit; excess hits ignored when no undamaged items remain.
